job.job_description:
Experience: 3 to 8 Years | Location: Pune | Notice Period: Immediate to 45 Days




About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to unlock AI's potential across the organization by rapidly delivering business-driven AI solutions integrating existing cloud AI models and APIs rather than building new algorithms. You'll design digital agents and pragmatic, secure, maintainable AI solutions that drive real business value.




Key Responsibilities

Deliver business-driven AI solutions by integrating cloud AI models/APIs into microservices and workflows
Translate business goals into technically feasible AI solutions, working with data scientists, architects, and full-stack engineers
Design, deploy, and monitor intelligent agents for automation and personalization
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps)
Maintain documentation (API references, runbooks, architecture diagrams) and conduct demos/training
Ensure AI solutions comply with responsible AI standards



Required Skills

Hands-on experience with GCP (Vertex AI, Document AI, BigQuery ML) OR Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services)
Strong knowledge of LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure OpenAI) and prompt/context engineering
Proficiency in Python and SQL (mandatory)
Understanding of microservices architecture (API-driven, event-driven patterns)
Familiarity with agentic frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, Semantic Kernel)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines on cloud platforms
Excellent English communication and structured problem-solving skills



Eligibility

Immediate joiners or notice period up to 45 days
Based in Pune or open to relocating
